ns2:course.label: Ethics in Biotechnology
ns2:course.description: Covers principles of ethics related to developments in biotechnology, the impact of biotechnology on environments, health, and food, and societal perception and conflict in addressing biotechnology. The course includes discussion, debate, and conflict resolution. Same as ANSC 465 and CPSC 465. Prerequisite: CPSC 261 or CPSC 265.
